description: Registry of known-flaky CI failures, matched by failure-output substring/regex. Checked by scripts/check_flake.py so a session debugging a red run can tell a known flake from a novel failure without re-diagnosing from scratch. See docs/operations/local-and-production.md (## CI) for how it's used.

flakes.reason: scripts/load_test_ingestion.py measures real wall-clock throughput for 500 synthetic docs against a fixed --floor-docs-per-sec 50.0; under shared-runner CPU load the fake-embedder pipeline occasionally dips below the floor (observed 45.2 docs/sec in CI) even though no documents failed. Not a real regression -- re-run the job.
flakes.evidence: gh run view 40223083512 --log-failed (run on main, 2026-10-25T18:49:36Z): "AssertionError: load test failed:\ncount=500 ... throughput=45.2 docs/sec processed=500 stats={'processed': 500, 'indexed': 500, 'deleted': 0, 'rejected': 0, 'dead_lettered': 0, 'duplicates': 0, 'malformed': 0}\nLOAD TEST FAILED: throughput 45.2 < floor 50.0"
